items.name: VEVELSTAD Bed frame - white Queen
items.description: VEVELSTAD Bed frame - white Queen. The clean and simple design goes well with other bedroom furniture and fits perfectly in any modern bedroom. White powder-coated metal and visible screws add a modern look to the bed frame. The powder-coated metal makes the bed frame easy to clean and maintain.

items.why: Natural jute-look flatweave warms floor and suits room size
items.description: LOHALS Rug, flatwoven - natural 4 ' 4 "x6 ' 5 ". The jute has natural color variations that make each rug distinct and unique. items.name: RANARP Floor/reading lamp - black
items.why: Black adjustable reading lamp provides accent and task light
items.description: RANARP Floor/reading lamp - black. You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable. Provides a directed light that is great for reading. Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E26. May be completed with other lamps in the same series.

items.description: HOVET Mirror - oak effect/brown 30 3/4x77 1/8 ". An aluminum frame in an elegant brown oak-effect gives the mirror a soft, warm look. HOVET mirror can hang either on a wall or be placed on the floor anchored and tilted against a wall. Can be hung horizontally or vertically.
